for_each: select id,code from shipments order by code
name: condition-report
title: Cargo condition report

sections.title: Shipment
sections.sql: select code,name,customer,carrier,site,status from shipments where id=$1

sections.title: Inspection history
sections.sql: select code,inspected_at,stage,inspector,condition,units,expected_units,expected_seal,seal_observed,notes from inspections where shipment_id=$1 order by inspected_at

sections.title: Evidence register
sections.sql: select e.name,e.sha256,e.captured_at,e.added_by from evidence e join inspections i on i.id=e.inspection_id where i.shipment_id=$1

for_each: select id,code from shipments order by code
name: handover-record
title: Cargo handover record

sections.title: Shipment
sections.sql: select code,name,customer,carrier,site,status from shipments where id=$1

sections.title: Recorded receipts
sections.note: Named acknowledgement and receipt reference only. This is not signature verification.
sections.sql: select from_party,to_party,happened_at,accepted_by,receipt_ref,notes from handovers where shipment_id=$1 order by happened_at

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,finding,basis from v_compliance where shipment_id=$1
